name: Bagel
summary: Golden bagel with a hole: plain, sesame-seeded, or a cut half with cream cheese, for breakfast and bakery scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the bagel rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~380 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: variant
params.note: plain = golden ring; sesame = seeds on top; cream = ring with a cut half in front spread with cream cheese

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
